# Repository Instructions

## Git and commit attribution

- Do not add `Co-authored-by` trailers to commit messages.
- Do not add `Generated by`, `Assisted by`, or similar AI attribution footers unless legally or contractually required.
- Do not modify the configured Git author or committer identity.
- Do not impersonate other contributors or rewrite existing commit history.
- Do not automatically commit, push, create pull requests, or merge changes unless explicitly requested.
- Leave completed code changes uncommitted for review.
- When asked to commit, use concise, conventional commit messages without additional trailers.
- Preserve copyright notices, licenses, and attribution required by third-party code.

## Development workflow

- Implement changes in small, testable increments.
- Run relevant tests before reporting completion.
- Do not introduce unnecessary paid services.
- Prefer GitHub-native infrastructure and free static hosting where technically appropriate.
- Never commit API keys, passwords, cookies, tokens, or personal credentials.
- Do not deploy or publish changes without explicit approval.
